name: MOSS-Image SFT ComfyUI
readme:
# MOSS-Image SFT ComfyUI

Deploy → **Connect → MOSS ComfyUI** → choose a workflow → enter a prompt → Run.

Choose one **RTX 4090 (24 GB)**, the validated GPU. Runpod supplies the connection token. No separate password, Hugging Face token, terminal command or storage edit is required for first use. The connection page shows preparation progress while six public model files (23.51 GB) download and verify. The fresh 0.1.2 test became ready about 18 min 39 s after the deployment response; host placement and network speeds vary. Retained models can be reused.

## Models and LoRAs

Your files use `/workspace/ComfyUI`. Upload compatible MOSS-Image SFT adapters to **`/workspace/ComfyUI/models/loras`** (plural), refresh the model list, then choose the adapter in the second LoRA slot and set its strength. `/opt/comfyui/models` points to the same model tree. Version 0.1.2 migrates the earlier managed `/workspace/moss` directory while preserving existing files; conflicting roots or files stop migration without replacement.

## Included workflows

- SFT Photography — BF16, 1216×1664, 25 steps, CFG 2.5.
- SFT Fast — INT8 with two compatible LoRA slots, 1024×1024.
- Image variation — experimental latent repainting.
- Official SFT — browser prompt enhancement.

Compatible CUDA 13.0 and 13.2 hosts are enabled. The template requests a 60 GB container disk. For retained models, edited workflows and images, select persistent storage mounted at `/workspace` in Runpod Storage; the launch screen selects that separately. Preserve the volume when stopping.

## Startup script

The image includes `/opt/moss/scripts/entrypoint.sh`, explicitly selected as the Container start command. It initializes Runpod SSH, starts the protected progress page, prepares models and supervises ComfyUI through the image's `tini` entry point. No external startup-script download is needed.

The exact 0.1.2 image passed fresh GPU presets, all four browser imports, prompt enhancement, real browser Run-button generation on the upgraded Pod, optional second-LoRA API inference and restart-preservation checks. Execution tests do not guarantee a particular aesthetic result.

Documentation, API examples, licenses and validation: https://github.com/akhilsivanand/moss-runpod
